title: simcadval diagnosis
description: What differs between World A (DD4hep, reference) and World B (STEP via G4OCCT, candidate) in one simcadval case, where, by how much, and the evidence. Written by an investigating agent through svtool submit_diagnosis, which checks it against this schema and the case, then renders diagnosis.md.

findings.description: One entry per mismatch family with a single cause. A 'no_difference' finding stands alone.

unexplained.description: Mismatch not covered by any finding.

next_steps.description: What would settle the open points.

agent.description: Who wrote this diagnosis (for evaluation records).

category.description: placement: a part is shifted, rotated or the wrong size in B. material: a part has the wrong material in B. missing_part: a part of A is absent in B. extra_part: B has a part A lacks. navigation_artifact: B's shapes are right but G4OCCT navigates them wrongly. no_difference: the worlds agree at floating-point level. unclear: the evidence does not separate the categories.

parts.description: Affected parts as <volume>@<id> (export ids), or <volume>@* for every part with that volume name. Empty only for no_difference.

materials.description: The material transition this finding explains: what A has and what B has instead.

share_of_mismatch.description: Fraction of the case's ray mismatch length that this finding explains.

magnitude.description: Size of the effect. summary is free text; the other fields are optional and machine-readable.

displacement_mm.description: placement: translation D of the part in B relative to A, global frame.

rotation_mrad.description: placement: small rotation vector of the part in B relative to A, global frame.

boundary_shift_mm.description: placement: typical shift of the part's boundaries along rays.

material_b.description: material: the material B assigns to the part(s).

explanation.description: Why this category: how the evidence rules out the others.

call.description: id of an svtool call of this investigation (calls.jsonl).

shows.description: the values or lines of that call's output that support the finding.
